messages:
Sophie: Hey team — short notice: my flight got moved and I need someone to cover a chunk of oncall this weekend. Can't do Sat 18:00-00:00 UTC and part of Sun morning. Can someone pick up Sat eve or Sun morning?

Sophie: Quick context: DB migration runs Fri->Sat night, expect brief latency spikes around 02:00-04:00 UTC. No high-risk deploys scheduled for Sat, but there's a canary for model-x on Fri night. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall

Sophie: Prewarm checklist (quick):
- health: `curl -sS https://internal/health | jq .`
- prewarm cache: `scripts/prewarm_cache.sh --keys 2000` (or `--sample 200` to limit tokens)
- watch /v1/generate errors and latency in the runtime dashboard

oncall-bot: Reminder — scheduled rotation needs ack. Please react with :white_check_mark:.

Amar: I can take Sat 18:00-00:00 UTC. I'll prewarm ~2h before my block. Any outstanding deploys I should know about?

Sophie: Thanks @Amar! No full-prod deploys scheduled Sat. Canary for model-x Friday night — if /v1/generate error rate > 2% for 5m, rollback: `deploy rollback model-x`. Also check traces for increasing tail-latency on long-seq routes.

Amar: Ack. I'll watch the Datadog dashboard `runtime/errors` and set a short alert threshold for the window.

Lee: I can pick up Sun 08:00-16:00 UTC if that helps. @Sophie, any open escalations to pass on? I prefer pairing for the first 30m.

Sophie: Appreciated @Lee. Only thing to note is perf regression ticket INT-452 (low priority) — not blocking but could increase CPU on some endpoints. Happy to do a 20m huddle at 07:30 UTC to hand off. Key ops to hand over:
- cache warmup script: `scripts/prewarm_cache.sh --keys 2000`
- check kv cache hit rate in Console -> Observability -> Caches
- spot-check embeddings queue: `kubectl logs -l app=embedder -c worker | tail -n 200`

Amar: quick Q — the warmup script generates tokens; will that spike billing during my block? Trying to avoid unexpected cost.

Sophie: Warmup does count tokens but it's a small overhead: roughly ~5% of normal token usage vs cold misses causing more latency and retries. If cost is a concern run `--sample 200` instead of full 2000; that reduces tokens while still seeding hot paths.

oncall-bot: Rotation ack recorded: Amar acknowledged at 2412003501.

Lee: Calendar blocks added for Sun 08:00-16:00. Ping me in #eng-oncall if you want me earlier or to start pairing.

Sophie: Thanks both — I'll DM the short handoff notes and paste the minimal runbook snippets in the huddle. Appreciate the cover :sparkles:

Amar: Cool, I'll post back once prewarm is done and the canary is green. :thumbsup:

Lee: Got it, see you on the huddle.
